purpose: Isolate XLS diagnostic observer overhead and establish plain OwnedSource production lifecycle baselines. No production speedup claim.
isolation: Fresh sequential child per repetition; warmup and retained samples share process. No concurrent build/test/benchmark.
acceptance: All logical I/O counters and output hashes equivalent; observer scope marker must differ explicitly. Source observer result measures instrumentation change only. Review >5% eager latency/RSS regressions. Plain source results single-revision baseline only.
timer: Existing open/query brackets, input clone and source construction outside; output semantic oracle and locality validation outside.
memory: Allocation calls include reallocations; peak/live values are process snapshots; RSS is whole-process.
limitations: No cold-cache or physical I/O claim
No scaling or exact L1/LLC claim

counters.scope: Whole process, scaled multiplexed events; not operation IPC or cache miss rate
